level_one.title: Journeyman Cooking
level_one.description: Each Hero hit by Ez-Thro Dynamite heals you for 8% of maximum Health.  Quest: Hitting Heroes with Ez-Thro Dynamite permanently increases your maximum Health by 10, to a maximum of 750 bonus Health.

level_four.title: Brute Force
level_four.description: Increase the range of Loot Hoard by 25% and its damage by 50%.  Quest: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow permanently increases Basic Attack damage by 2, to a maximum of 150 bonus damage. Enemy Heroes that hit terrain grant an additional 6 damage.

level_seven.title: Dense Blasting Powder
level_seven.description: Instant detonations of Ez-Thro Dynamite creates an additional dynamite behind the Hero hit.  Hitting the bundle of Ez-Thro Dynamite with Staggering Blow breaks it into three sticks and launches them forward in an arc.

level_ten.title: Hoardapult
level_ten.description: Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.  Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

level_thirteen.title: Bloodthirst
level_thirteen.description: Damaging Heroes with Basic Attacks, Staggering Blow, or Hogg Wild heals you for 33% of the damage dealt.

level_sixteen.title: Headbanger
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes Stunned by Staggering Blow take an additional 8% of their maximum Health as damage and are Stunned for an additional 0.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Hyper Shift
level_one.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 second.

level_four.title: Magic Spit
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Peekaboo!
level_seven.description: Phase Shifting to an ally grants both Brightwing and her target a 335 (+4% per level) Shield for 4 seconds and reveals a large area around them for 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Emerald Wind
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and pushing enemies away.

level_thirteen.title: Pixie Power
level_thirteen.description: Reduce the cooldown of Pixie Dust by 3 seconds and increase the Spell Armor granted by 25.

level_sixteen.title: Hush!
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes hit by the center of Arcane Flare are Silenced for 1 second and deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Widowmakers
level_one.description: Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second.  Reward: After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their attack damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

level_four.title: Hexed Crawlers
level_four.description: Corpse Spiders restore 1% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana when they attack an enemy Hero.

level_seven.title: Spirit of Arachyr
level_seven.description: The number of Corpse Spiders spawned is increased from 3 to 4. If Corpse Spiders' jar hits only one enemy, it creates an additional spider.

level_ten.title: Gargantuan
level_ten.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area, losing Health over 29 seconds. Deals 100 (+4% per level) damage when summoned, attacks for 140 (+4% per level) damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 240 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ice Block
level_thirteen.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Spider Colony
level_sixteen.description: Corpse Spider Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 0.125 seconds.

level_one.title: Viciousness
level_one.description: Increases Inner Beast's duration to 4 seconds, and causes Ability damage to also refresh its duration.

level_four.title: Thick Skin
level_four.description: Using Darkflight grants 50 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks while in Worgen Form, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

level_seven.title: Quicksilver Bullets
level_seven.description: Increases Greymane's Human Basic Attack range by 1.1.

level_ten.title: Cursed Bullet
level_ten.description: Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage.  Does not affect Vehicles.

level_thirteen.title: On the Prowl
level_thirteen.description: Inner Beast increases Movement Speed by 30% once it has been active for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Executioner
level_sixteen.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Warbreaker
level_one.description: Quest: Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker.  Reward: After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to Heroes.  Reward: After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

level_four.title: Indomitable
level_four.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Intimidation
level_seven.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Warlord's Challenge
level_ten.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Defensive Measures
level_thirteen.description: If Groundbreaker Stuns a Hero, Garrosh gains a 350 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Seasoned Soldier
level_sixteen.description: Gain 5% maximum Health, increase Groundbreaker's Slow duration by 1 second, and Bloodthirst gains an additional charge.

level_one.title: Power Word: Shield
level_one.description: While Divine Star is traveling out, allies in its path gain a Shield that absorbs 128 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.  If Divine Star hits an enemy Hero, Anduin gains a Shield that absorbs 185 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.

level_four.title: Piercing Light
level_four.description: Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero.  Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

level_seven.title: Binding Heal
level_seven.description: Casting Flash Heal on an ally heals Anduin for 135 (+4% per level).

level_ten.title: Lightbomb
level_ten.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Speed of the Pious
level_thirteen.description: While Divine Star is traveling, gain 30% Movement Speed. Each allied Hero healed by Divine Star on its return to Anduin reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Glyph of Faith
level_sixteen.description: Leap of Faith gains a 2nd charge.

level_twenty.title: Censure
level_twenty.description: Chastise Stuns for 0.75 seconds and its Root duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Shackler
level_one.description: While Bone Armor is active, nearby enemies are Slowed by 35% for 1 second. Basic Attacks against Heroes that are Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor by 2 seconds.

level_four.title: Jailors
level_four.description: Bone Prison spawns 2 Skeletal Warriors.  These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.  Quest: Spawn 80 Skeletal Warriors.  Reward: While fixating on an enemy, Skeletal Warriors gain 25% Movement and Attack Speed.

level_seven.title: Trag'Oul's Essence
level_seven.description: Every time a Skeletal Warrior attacks an enemy, restore 0.5% of Xul's maximum Health and 0.2% of his maximum Mana.

level_ten.title: Skeletal Mages
level_ten.description: Vector Targeting Summon 4 Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for 47 (+4% per level) damage a second and Slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Last up to 15 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Echoes of Death
level_thirteen.description: Spectral Scythe spawns 2 additional scythes next to the first after 1.5 seconds, dealing 40% damage.

level_sixteen.title: Decrepify
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes that are damaged by Spectral Scythe or Skeletal Warriors are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Cold Hand of Death
level_twenty.description: Increase the Slow of Frost Mages by 20%.   Every 5th Spectral Scythe that hits enemy Heroes spawns a Frost Mage instead of a Skeletal Warrior at their location.

level_one.title: Feast on Fear
level_one.description: Stunning an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower heals Diablo for 10% of his maximum Health over 3 seconds.

level_four.title: Sacrificial Soul
level_four.description: Stunning a Hero with Shadow Charge grants 10 Souls and 20 Armor for 3 seconds. While at 100 Souls, increase this Armor to 40.

level_seven.title: Malevolence
level_seven.description: Basic Abilities cause Diablo's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds to deal an additional 100 (+4% per level) Spell Damage. Stores up to 2 charges.

level_ten.title: Apocalypse
level_ten.description: Create a demonic rune under each enemy Hero on the battleground. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Devastating Charge
level_thirteen.description: Increase Shadow Charge's terrain collision damage by 50%.  Quest: Hit an enemy Hero against terrain 5 times.  Reward: Hitting enemy Heroes against terrain reduces their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Domination
level_sixteen.description: Casting Overpower resets the cooldown of Shadow Charge.

level_twenty.title: Dying Breath
level_twenty.description: Apocalypse's cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit (to a minimum of 5 seconds) and is cast for free when Diablo dies.

level_one.title: Aether Walker
level_one.description: Teleport costs no Mana. If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds. Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

level_four.title: Triumvirate
level_four.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

level_seven.title: Calamity
level_seven.description: Teleport does 300 (+3% per level) damage to enemy Heroes near the destination.

level_ten.title: Wave Of Force
level_ten.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Illusionist
level_thirteen.description: If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed.  This effect has a 4 second cooldown.  Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

level_sixteen.title: Diamond Skin
level_sixteen.description: Teleport grants a Shield equal to 25% of Li-Ming's maximum Health for 4 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Repulsion
level_twenty.description: Increases Wave of Force knockback distance by 175% and increases its cast range by 95%.

level_one.title: Fire At Will
level_one.description: Quest: Hitting a Hero with Multishot grants 2 Hatred and permanently increases its damage by 2.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes with Multishot, increase its damage by 40.

level_four.title: Arsenal
level_four.description: Increase the range of Multishot by 20%. Multishot also fires 3 grenades that deal 100 (+4% per level) damage and refund 25 Mana after hitting enemy Heroes.

level_seven.title: Frost Shot
level_seven.description: Multishot Slows enemies by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Hungering Arrows deals 25% more damage to Slowed enemies.

level_ten.title: Strafe
level_ten.description: Rapidly attack enemies within 10 range for 70 (+4% per level) damage per hit, prioritizing Heroes over Minions. Valla is able to move and use Vault while strafing. Lasts for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Gloom
level_thirteen.description: Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds.  Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2 (+4% per level) Health per second.

level_sixteen.title: Manticore
level_sixteen.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 4% of their maximum Health as damage.

level_twenty.title: Death Siphon
level_twenty.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Strafe increases its duration by 0.125 seconds. Strafe also fires penetrating bolts in a line for 34 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds.
